content: We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more en-US 60 Hadley Designs LLC: Amazon Brand Manager Anywhere in the World Texas Paid Social Media Advertising, Product Marketing, Product Lifecycle Management, Power BI/Tableau, Product Listing, and Amazon Seller Central Sales and Marketing Full-Time <img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6760/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" /> <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Flower Mound, TX, USA <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://www.hadleydesigns.com">http://www.hadleydesigns.com</a> </p> <div> <p><strong>Own Your Catalog Like a Business, and Win on Amazon.</strong></p> <p>Hadley Designs is seeking an Amazon Brand Manager to take full ownership of a multi-million dollar group of our products on Amazon, as the product manager, the merchandiser, and the CEO of that catalog. This is a high-impact role for an e-commerce brand builder who brings real judgment, reads a market quickly, and knows how to grow net profit, not just sales.</p> <p>You will report to the leader of our Amazon channel and work as part of a small, high-performing Amazon team. While this role operates deeply within Amazon, we welcome candidates who have built brands across e-commerce, DTC, or marketplace environments and are excited to bring that experience to a scaled Amazon catalog.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>How You'll Win at Hadley Designs</strong></p> <p>You bring the judgment. We bring the brand, the catalog, and the team.</p> <ul> <li>Learn our brand. Get to know our brand, our expectations, your catalog group, and the standards and SOPs our team runs on.</li> <li>Run your catalog as its CEO. Make the calls on pricing, listings, imagery, promotions, and inventory, and own the net profit that results.</li> <li>Challenge the status quo. Bring better ideas, back them with a clear point of view, and help us raise the bar.</li> </ul> <p>We are looking for thinkers who are coachable and confident, not people waiting for a playbook.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You'll Own</strong></p> <ul> <li>End-to-end ownership of your catalog group's performance, including revenue, net profit, pricing, advertising, and inventory</li> <li>Reading the competitive landscape, from merchandising and listings to imagery and pricing, and responding with strategy rather than reacting to every price drop</li> <li>Finding inspiration outside Amazon, on Etsy, TikTok, Pinterest, and in wider trends, and turning it into product and format ideas</li> <li>Product and format relaunches that lift your catalog</li> <li>How your products look and compete on the page, from main images to packaging and format</li> <li>Elevating our brand experience on Amazon so your catalog protects its margin and earns a higher price</li> <li>Advertising, listings, experiments, and inventory planning with our supply chain team, used as levers toward profit</li> <li>AI workflows that handle the routine work, so your time goes to the decisions that grow the catalog</li> <li>Clear weekly reporting on results, risks, and next moves</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p> <p><strong>Within your first 90 days, you will:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Learn our brand, expectations, catalog group, and SOPs, and share a clear read of your competitive landscape</li> <li>Own your catalog's weekly numbers and make the first judgment calls that protect margin and lift results</li> <li>Bring forward product and format ideas, including ones inspired from outside Amazon, with at least one relaunch in motion</li> <li>Challenge at least one way we do things with a better one, and be measured on the net profit you deliver</li> </ul> </div> <h2>Requirements</h2> <div> <p><strong>Who You Are</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of experience owning a product line or catalog on Amazon, in e-commerce, or in marketplaces, end to end as a business</li> <li>A strong visual eye, and you see what wins on the page, not only in the data</li> <li>You read competitors and markets and can explain your reasoning, not just the answer</li> <li>You find ideas outside Amazon and know how to turn a trend into a product or format</li> <li>You know the tactics that grow net profit and you have protected margin and price</li> <li>Deep, hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central and Amazon advertising</li> <li>AI capability, a CRM and documented SOPs. You use AI every day to get more done with less, which is a must-have here and a capability rather than any one tool, and you are excited to build how we use all three now and going forward</li> <li>Very organized and buttoned up, and you follow through until the job is done</li> <li>Clear, confident spoken and written English</li> <li>Coachable and quick to learn our way, and confident enough to challenge it</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>This is an ownership role for an experienced brand builder, not a virtual assistant position.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> </div> <h2>Benefits</h2> <div> <p><strong>Why You'll Thrive Here</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own a multi-million dollar Amazon catalog with a team that's got the tools and trust to help you scale</li> <li>Join a high-growth crew that lives for innovation, data, and collective wins</li> <li>Remote full-time work with a flexible schedule</li> <li>Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO</li> <li>Personal development and autonomy over your time</li> <li>An established company, 10+ years strong, ready to soar higher with you onboard</li> </ul> </div> <p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hadley-designs-llc-amazon-brand-manager">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hadley-designs-llc-amazon-brand-manager</a></p> Thu, 12 Nov 2026 19:09:19 +0000 Sat, 12 Dec 2026 19:09:19 +0000 https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hadley-designs-llc-amazon-brand-manager https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hadley-designs-llc-amazon-brand-manager Veeva Systems: IT Consultant -
